-2. When the question asks for "details", "information", "all columns", or "which [entity]" without specifying particular fields, return all relevant columns from the main table(s), not just one identifier or name column.

proposal.root_cause: Column projection errors (SELECT * vs specific cols) and NULL-handling in NOT IN/EXISTS
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to explicitly forbid `SELECT *` unless all columns are strictly necessary, instructing the model to select only relevant columns. Also add a rule that for 'no X' / exclusion queries, `NOT EXISTS` or explicit `IS NOT NULL` checks are mandatory to avoid empty results from NULLs in subqueries.
